Container.Name: tinyMediaManagerTouch
Container.Overview: tinyMediaManager without desktop GUI: only the HTTP API and the touch-friendly web UI (phone, tablet, PC). Experimental build.

Config.Name: Web UI port
Config.Description: Port of the web UI and the HTTP API.

Config.Name: API key
Config.Description: Password asked by the web UI (and API key of the HTTP API). Choose a long random value.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Settings, database, image cache and logs.

Config.Name: Movies
Config.Description: Your movie folder. Read-only is the safe choice for a first test; switch to read/write to let tinyMediaManager write NFO files and artwork.

Config.Name: TV shows
Config.Description: Your TV show folder. Read-only is the safe choice for a first test; switch to read/write to let tinyMediaManager write NFO files and artwork.

Config.Name: Movie data sources
Config.Description: Movie folders inside the container, separated by ; - added to the settings on start. Clear it if you do not map a movie folder.

Config.Name: TV show data sources
Config.Description: TV show folders inside the container, separated by ; - added to the settings on start. Clear it if you do not map a TV show folder.

Config.Name: Java options
Config.Description: JVM options; raise -Xmx for very large libraries.
